project_overview.title: The Archive — Bhuvan M. Acharya
project_overview.sub_title: Interactive Editorial Personal Portfolio & Digital Identity
project_overview.author: Bhuvan M. Acharya
project_overview.design_archetype: Swiss Editorial Minimalism × Futuristic Digital Architecture × Creative Brutalism

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-normal leading-[1.05] tracking-tight font-serif
hierarchy_rules.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-normal leading-[1.15] font-serif

layout_and_grid.base_grid: 12-column Swiss editorial grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8)
layout_and_grid.borders: 1px hairline borders (border-[#25251F]/10 in light mode, border-[#DCDDD9]/10 in dark mode)
anti_patterns: No muddy glassmorphism on text areas
No stock photography decorations without story context
No text-7xl to text-9xl headings (ceiling is text-6xl)

threejs_orbital_sculpture.description: Interactive 3D geometry featuring concentric orbital rings with real-time mouse parallax, scroll-linked rotation speed, and dynamic light reflections
threejs_orbital_sculpture.fallback: Clean vector SVG orbital diagram rendered seamlessly when window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') is active
threejs_orbital_sculpture.lighting: Dual directional lights + subtle ambient light to keep metallic/matte geometric surfaces rich and visible

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: MANDATORY. Every interactive element (navigation links, filter buttons, project cards, accordion toggles, contact inputs, theme switches) MUST include a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use light background #F1EEE7 as default for the main page, and dark background #111318 specifically for case studies and the research laboratory section.
Do NOT center-align the main application container (.App text-align center is banned). Use clean asymmetric 12-column Swiss grids.
Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals, micro-interactions, page route transitions, and timeline expansion.
Provide a robust 3D orbital sculpture using Three.js/R3F with fallback vector graphics for reduced motion.
